decoder_reconstruction: G(E(y)) does not select lambda, a budget, or a method.
decoder_sharing: A, B, C, and D use one decoder per seed and training budget.
fixed_metric: RMSE on the complement of Omega_13, common to all three fractions.
lambda_rule: Unobserved validation RMSE. Full CLP uses the best strictly positive lambda. Lambda 0 with h(u) is clp_init_only. Lambda 0 with a zero code is measurement-only.
mask_protocol: Omega_4, Omega_6, and Omega_13 are prefixes of one permutation per seed.
noise_protocol: One N(0, 0.01^2) field per split is drawn after the permutation. Each mask slices that field. Shared coordinates keep the same noise.
nonconvex_caveat: Differences among A, B, and C are not isolated causal effects. Recovery is non-convex, and measurement-only uses a different restart seed.
paired_gain_sign: clp_minus_comparator = RMSE_CLP - RMSE_comparator. Negative favors CLP.
profile_rule: Depth-order first, middle, and last test windows, plus the test window with the largest CLP full-window RMSE at 24 training windows and 4 observations.
val_interpretation: F06-1 has eight overlapping windows from one well. Lambda selection is not strong statistical evidence.
